title: DOH: US-bound travelers must declare recent DRC visits amid Ebola

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Starting Nov. 3, passengers traveling by air to the United States must attest that they have not recently been to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid an Ebola virus outbreak there, the Department of Health-Bureau of Quarantine (DOH-BOQ) said. In an advisory, the DOH-BOQ said the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention had implemented additional travel requirements.
